comments.content: get_doc_ids_by_doc_names returns None when the query is falsy and will generate an invalid `WHERE name IN ()` when doc_names is empty. Return [] consistently and guard against empty input before building the IN clause to avoid TypeError/SQL errors downstream in document_rm.

doc_ids is assumed to be a list after get_doc_ids_by_doc_names. If the helper returns None or raises on an empty IN clause, `if doc_id not in doc_ids` and `DocumentService.get_by_ids(doc_ids)` will raise TypeError. Normalize doc_ids to [] and handle the empty-name case before building doc_dic.
